limitations: This freeze archives existing evidence; no fresh correctness or GPU performance run was performed.
One paged performance run and two local-KV runs on the same H100 type; physical GPU identity was not recorded for a paired comparison.
No measured stock-vLLM, SGLang, or from-scratch comparison on this workload.
GSM8K prompt parity is not a dataset accuracy or output-quality measurement.
Paged Engine greedy tokens are checked, but teacher-forced logits and probe logits call the local model path directly in the existing harness.
Existing teacher-forced assertions cover argmax, not numeric or KL tolerance; no new numerical threshold has been adopted.
Longest HF parity prompt is 6896 tokens; performance context is 8192 tokens.
128-token GSM8K parity belongs to the earlier local-KV path; paged Engine checks use 16 decode tokens.
Images, prefix-cache reuse, and memory-pressure retraction are not GPU-qualified.
Runtime package installation inventory is incomplete; locks, build recipe, and recorded versions are archived.
Weights, virtualenvs, native build outputs, credentials, ignored local trees, and git history are not included in the archive; model and source revisions are pinned.
Some module docstrings and earlier reports still describe local-KV as current; code and the later cache-contract report establish the current paged default.

The cache-contract report states a 21–43% paging gain. Recomputing against the contemporaneous same-source local control gives 16–43%; batch 4 is +16.3%. The earlier local baseline gives +21.3% at batch 4.

restore.instructions: Extract source-and-evidence.tar.gz into a new empty directory. It contains working-tree file contents, including the modified HF reference and untracked oracle fixtures. Do not apply working-tree.patch again; it is an audit record against the pinned repository commit. The archive excludes Git metadata and installed environments. Follow archived REPRODUCE.md for environment setup, and archived reports/cache-contract.md plus manifest presets for paged/local distinctions.
